$comment: Purpose: record the P05.2 durable queue boundary. Behavior: define transactional enqueue, lease ownership and truthful non-claims. Refs: main_implementation plan.md P05.2; api design.md §§5.1, 18.1; Phase: P05.

decisions.decision: Create the compute run, budget reservation, job queue record and queued outbox event in one tenant-scoped transaction.
decisions.reason: A rollback cannot leave a spend reservation, run or published work notification without the other durable records.

decisions.decision: Use PostgreSQL row locking, database clock timestamps, UUID attempt identities and a monotonically increasing job generation as the lease fence.
decisions.reason: A delayed worker cannot renew or complete after expiry, cancellation or a later claim.

decisions.decision: Keep queue completion separate from scientific outcome publication.
decisions.reason: P05.2 provides work ownership only; P05.3 and later stages must still validate approved method/source inputs and commit actual evidence before any result is reported.

not_claimed: worker execution, retry policy or artifact publication
P05 phase or upstream gate acceptance
